name: CCL Products (India) Ltd
about: CCL Products (India) is engaged in the production, trading and distribution of Coffee. The Company has business operations mainly in India, Vietnam and Switzerland countries.(Source : 202003 Annual Report Page No:119)
keyPoints: Company History[1][2] CCL was initially registered as The Sahayak Finance and Investment Corporation Limited in 1961. The name was changed to Continental Coffee Limited in 1994 when it started producing instant coffee, and finally to the present name of CCL in 2002.
